instruction: Add background music to the video '/home/user/fullvideo.mp4' in GIMP, and adjust its volume to 50%.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP has no audio editing or mixing capabilities whatsoever. GIMP is purely an image manipulation program and cannot work with audio tracks, add background music, or adjust audio volumes in video files.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP is an image manipulation program and cannot perform audio/video editing operations
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate choice for tasks that cannot be completed due to fundamental application limitations
